changes.match: Match found screen on the phone, with League's sound, to accept or decline.
changes.select: Your champion's build on the phone in champion select, with one button to import it all.
changes.modes: Home by mode: Normal, Ranked, ARAM, ARAM: Mayhem and Arena, each with what matters in it.
changes.notify: Your phone lets you know when you find a match, even with the app closed, and you can accept it from the notification.
changes.phoneUpdate: The phone app updates itself from its Settings, like Xyra on the PC.
changes.patch: Patch buffs and nerfs for your champions, in Meta and on your phone.
changes.bench: A button to take the recommended champion from the bench, on the PC and on your phone.
changes.account: Your account in the sidebar: history of every mode, mastery and challenges about to level up.

builtWith: Made with Rust, Tauri and Svelte. The in-game overlay is native: no browser, almost no memory.
available: A new version is out: v{{version}}.
installHint: Xyra closes and opens the installer; your settings and games are kept.
